paragraphs.text: Aevar Borg was a Terisian guide during the Thaw of Dominaria .

Shortly before the Battle of Kjeldor , Aevar Borg led Arcum Dagsson to Ronom Glacier and uncovered the last of the Phyrexian War Beasts frozen inside. After accidentally waking the giant beast up, they succeeded in activating a powerful bomb that blew the creature apart, keeping it from Heidar 's clutches.
